intro.text: The spren bonded to Renarin Kholin, who grants him the Surges of the Truthwatchers and can take the form of his Shardblade.
A mistspren bonded to Renarin Kholin as a Truthwatcher. Corrupted by the Unmade Sja-anat before the bond, he looks unlike other mistspren and shares strange visions of the future with Renarin.

items.text: Before he bonded Renarin, Glys was changed by the Unmade Sja-anat, a process she calls Enlightening. He does not remember it well.
Glys's bond with Renarin was already forming when Adolin gave Renarin the Shardblade he had won from Salinor Eved. It was strong enough by then for Renarin to see visions of the Everstorm's coming.

Renarin thought something was wrong with him when he heard dead Shardblades screaming, until Glys explained that he was a Truthwatcher, making him one of the first four Radiants of the refounded order, with Shallan, Kaladin and Dalinar.

Unsure at first whether he could, Glys learned to manifest as a Shardblade soon after they reached Urithiru, and Renarin returned his dead Blade to Adolin. When Renarin went with Shallan to hunt Re-Shephir in the tower's library, Glys was frightened by the sense of wrongness and refused to speak.
Through their bond, Renarin saw visions showing him the gemstones hidden in the library room's walls and how to open their compartments.

During the Battle of Thaylen Field, Jasnah found Renarin and Glys at the Temple of Pailiah'Elin. For the first time, someone else saw Glys, and Jasnah and Ivory confirmed he was no ordinary mistspren. In a fit, Renarin and Glys saw visions of Jasnah killing Renarin and of Dalinar kneeling to Odium. When Jasnah spared him, Renarin realised their visions could be wrong.

After Renarin and the Thaylen Shardbearer Hrdalm subdued a thunderclast, Glys showed him how to dispel it with Stormlight. At the ramp to the city's Oathgate, another vision showed them Teft, now a Radiant, about to bring Kholin troops through it.

About a year on, Glys and Renarin marched with the coalition's army in Emul. Discussing a recent vision with Dalinar, Glys said he did not think their visions necessarily came from Odium, though Odium's wishes might taint them. He was worried by Sja-anat's silence and sensed her nearby.

Glys excitedly replayed the vision he had captured so Renarin could describe it, and made sure Renarin mentioned the blackness in the stained glass, showing that being near them shielded Dalinar from Odium's future sight.

Glys was hopeful they could overcome people's fear of those who see the future. He urged Renarin to tell Dalinar that other spren touched by Sja-anat wanted to bond humans, and that more pairs like them were needed, standing outside both men and singers. At his prompting, Renarin asked Sja-anat to consider Rlain, and she sent Tumi to judge him.

appearance.text: As a Shardblade, Glys is long and thin, with almost no crossguard and waving folds in the metal, as if forged.

Glys looks like a bright red crystalline snowflake that shimmers and drips light upwards, unlike ordinary mistspren, an effect of Sja-anat's corruption. He tends to stay invisible or hidden within Renarin, and can hide even from the Sighted, such as Rock.

personality.text: Little is known of Glys's personality, except that he is excitable and optimistic.
